title: Concatenating CNFs bounds their width
statement: Let $\psi_1, \dots, \psi_s$ be CNF formulas over $n$ variables, and let $\ell$ be a natural number such that each $\psi_i$ has width at most $\ell$. Then the CNF formula obtained by concatenating all of their clause lists into a single list has width at most $\ell$.
hypotheses_covered: a list of CNF formulas over n variables
